cohort: 1849 women who delivered a singleton fetus at late preterm birth period (34+0/7 to 36+6/7 weeks of gestation), including 132 women with GDM and 1717 women without GDM
finding: Late preterm delivery in women with GDM was associated with higher rates of cesarean delivery and higher neonatal birth weight but did not increase the risk for neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Women with GDM had a lower rate of spontaneous vaginal delivery (45.5% vs. 62.9%, p<0.001) and a higher rate of cesarean delivery (50.8% vs. 31.8%, p<0.001).
